text.en: Raju noticed that the metal spoon in hot tea became hot but the wooden handle of the ladle did not. "Heat travels better in metal," he said.

The sum of the kinetic and potential energy of the molecules is the internal energy, and when it flows out it is called heat energy. Temperature is the degree of hotness or coolness of a body. The scales are Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin, with F = (9/5)C + 32 and K = C + 273.15. Absolute zero is the temperature at which pressure and volume of a gas theoretically reach zero.
Heat moves in three ways. In conduction it flows through solids from the hotter to the cooler part without the molecules moving. In convection it is carried by the movement of liquids and gases. In radiation it travels as electromagnetic waves and needs no medium, as the Sun's heat does.
Heat capacity is the heat needed to raise the temperature of the whole body by 1 degree. Specific heat capacity is the heat needed to raise the temperature of unit mass by 1 degree, using Q = m c (change in T). When a substance changes state, such as ice melting, it takes in latent heat without a change in temperature.

prompt.en: A friend says Heat from the Sun reaches us by conduction. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: Between Sun and Earth there is almost no matter.
The heat reaches us by radiation.

points.en: Heat flows from hot to cold.
Latent heat changes state, not temperature.
